library.description: Thread and process pools composed from public RPC peers.

blocks.text: 在公开 RPC Peer 上组合线程与进程池。每个成员一个客户端操作槽，最少 in-flight 调度，平局轮转；忙时进入有限 FIFO。通信、握手、监督与错误仍由原 Peer 管理。
`spawn` 原样交给 `createThreadPeer`，支持 `true`、入口路径、URL 和现有配置。不同程序才需要入口。此例的两个文件由文档检查器构建并运行。

blocks.code:
import { createThreadPeer } from '@migaia/rpc-threads'

await createThreadPeer({ provide: { double: (value: number) => value * 2 } })

blocks.text: `spawn` 原样交给 `createProcessPeer`。入口、运行时与权限规则和原工厂一致。名字端点用于独立进程；池 API 创建自己的成员程序。
两个工厂都返回 `request / notify / stream / resize / close / stats`。没有 Proxy。

items: `size` 是正整数；`maxQueue` 默认 256，允许 0。所有槽忙且队列满时拒绝 `QUEUE_FULL`，不发送业务调用。
`stats()` 是池自身的客户端操作快照，不是远端 provider 并发。request 到 Promise 完成、notify 到发送 Promise 完成、stream 到 done/return/throw 才释放槽。
`stream` 是惰性 iterator：首次 `next()` 才接纳；未开始的 iterator 不阻碍关闭。长 stream 需要消费、return 或取消才能 drain。
`resize(size)` 按调用顺序增减成员，缩容等正在使用的成员完成。`close()` 停止新接纳并排空已接受的队列，重复调用返回同一 Promise。
`idleTimeoutMs` 设置为不超过 2147483647 毫秒的有限正数时，闲置成员通过原 `peer.close()` 退役，下一个任务通过原公开工厂补回目标大小。
原 supervisor 负责崩溃重启与重新绑定。默认裸 spawn 使用原 on-failure 策略和五次预算；不重置用户预算。恢复期间原 Peer 可以拒绝 `CLOSED`；恢复后未来新调用使用同一个 Peer。池不自动重放失败业务调用。
`probe` 接受 `@migaia/rpc-core/probe` 的一个 Probe 或只读 Probe 数组，并原样交给每个成员的公开 Peer 工厂；真实握手、ready 和重启仍由原 Peer 发出。多个成员共享 Probe 时用事件的 `endpointId` 区分成员。
派发后的 call options 和 signal 原样传给 Peer；排队阶段取消为 DOMException AbortError，`CALL_ABORTED` 的 cause 是原 reason。`timeoutMs` 从原 Peer 接收操作时起算，池不另建队列 deadline。

blocks.text: `spawn: true` 会重跑整个主入口，使用原 `isProcessChild()` / `await isThreadChild()` guard。相对字符串基于主入口目录；URL 精确。浏览器线程沿原 URL 规则；Node `.ts` 去类型不重写 `.js` 导入，使用编译输出或 loader。详细入口、认证与运行时边界见 rpc-process / rpc-threads 使用手册。

本包 source 为 `@migaia/rpc-pool`：`INVALID_OPTIONS`（TypeError/RangeError）、`POOL_CLOSED`、`QUEUE_FULL`、`CALL_ABORTED`（DOMException）、`CLOSE_FAILED`（AggregateError）。原 Native/Peer 错误保持自己的 source/code 与实例；启动回滚的 secondary cleanup 报告，原 primary 保留；关闭汇总保留原 errors/cause。
只依赖 rpc-core、rpc-process、rpc-threads 的公开入口。没有工作窃取、跨机器池或另一套 RPC/native supervision。

Pool options accept `scheduler?: IScheduler` for idle retirement. This controls the pool's own timers, while Peer restart/deadline policy still belongs to the original spawn sources. Idle handles cancel on reservation, retirement and close, and request optional unref so housekeeping alone does not keep a host alive. Current idleTimeoutMs bounds remain unchanged.

sections.heading: 1. 高阶用法：线程池、通知与 stream

blocks.text: 这些文件使用真实 Worker。类型参数描述远端方法，调用形式与 Peer 一致。

使用 `createProcessPool<T>({ spawn, size, maxQueue?, idleTimeoutMs?, probe? })`，同 README 的真实进程示例。不同程序可用 URL/路径；外语 JSON-RPC 使用原 `{ command, args, wire: 'jsonrpc', contract }`。通信本身不需要文件。此工厂保留 Process 的 call-options 类型，不提供 thread transfer。
两个池工厂都接受 `defineProbe()` 返回的原始 Probe 或只读 Probe 数组。`probe` 原样进入每个成员的 `createThreadPeer` / `createProcessPeer`，握手、ready 和监督重启事件沿原 Peer 路径发出。共享 Probe 的回调用 `endpointId` 区分成员；`seq` 仍属于对应端点，而非整个池的统一序号。
原 signal/options 对象进入 Peer。取消排队项仅移除那一项，`CALL_ABORTED` 的 cause 保留原 reason；已经派发的取消由原 Peer 执行。queue 等待不重算或缩短原 timeoutMs。
崩溃成员由原 supervisor 重新绑定；恢复期间调用可收到原 CLOSED，池不自动重放。关闭停止新 request/notify、首次 stream next 和 resize；已接受的工作排空后才关闭成员。stream 未消费完会延长 drain，使用 iterator.return 或 signal 取消。
缩容先回收闲置成员，忙成员结束后关闭；扩容只创建差额。闲置回收仍使用原公开 close/factory。stats 的 in-flight 是本池客户端操作，不是 provider concurrency；notify 的槽只覆盖原发送完成点。
池拥有自己创建的 Peer 和本地 FIFO，没有 Native 句柄、握手、admission 或 trust 权限入口。默认 queue 容量 256，maxQueue=0 禁止等待；overflow 在接纳前拒绝。

idleTimeoutMs 必须为有限正数且不超过 2147483647 毫秒，避免原生 timer 溢出变成立即回收。非法 size/maxQueue/idleTimeoutMs 在创建前以 TypeError/RangeError+INVALID_OPTIONS 拒绝。部分启动失败保留原 primary 并关闭本批已取得 Peer；secondary cleanup 报告。close 汇总原失败在 AggregateError.errors/cause，不只保留 code。source 与完整代码列表见 README。
支持环境继承原工厂。当前文档执行使用 Node 24 的真实 Process/Worker；Bun、Deno、浏览器线程仍受原入口、权限与 native lifetime 限制，不把 Node 文档结果当作其他运行时验证。

Pass a host or manual scheduler in the common options of createThreadPool/createProcessPool. The option and scheduler methods are captured before invoking a native Peer factory. Advancing a manual clock drives idle expiry; reserving a member and closing the pool remove their previous tasks. Task unref is a liveness hint, not a change to timeout duration. Native Peer methods and close results retain their original ownership and identity. This option does not replace a member's own supervision scheduler.

symbols.name: createProcessPool
symbols.signature: export declare function createProcessPool<TRemote = Record<never, never>>(options: IProcessPoolOptions): Promise<IProcessPool<TRemote>>;
symbols.purpose: Creates independent Process Peers and applies pool-owned client-slot scheduling. Every member receives the original spawn source and probe; native Process runtime, wire format, permissions and restart budget remain unchanged. The spawned program uses createProcessPeer to provide its methods.
symbols.core:
Promise<IProcessPool<TRemote>> preserving Process public call-option types, including no native transfer lists. Invalid pool input uses INVALID_OPTIONS and original acquisition errors pass through; caller owns explicit pool close.
size: Required positive integer target count selected by the caller. Initial construction acquires that many independent public Peers before exposing the pool.
maxQueue: Nonnegative integer bound on FIFO waiters, excluding operations already assigned to members. Zero rejects immediately when every slot is busy.
256 waiting operations; overflow rejects QUEUE_FULL without calling a Peer.
idleTimeoutMs: Finite positive idle duration no greater than 2147483647 milliseconds. Retires genuinely idle members through their original close; future demand recreates missing target capacity.
Omitted, disabling pool-owned idle retirement; native Peer supervision remains unchanged.
scheduler: IScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler or a compatible injected scheduler, controlling only pool idle timers and their optional unref.
systemScheduler from @migaia/utils/scheduler; Peer restart and deadline policy stays with each original spawn source.
spawn: Required NonNullable<IRuntimeProcessPeerOptions[spawn]> from @migaia/rpc-process: true for the guarded current entry, path, URL or original process source configuration. The program provides methods through createProcessPeer and the pool forwards the exact source unchanged.
probe: One IRpcProbe or readonly probe array from @migaia/rpc-core/probe, for example from createRpcDevtools. The exact same handle is forwarded to every public member factory; use event endpointId to distinguish members.
Omitted; no pool-added source probe is passed to member factories.
symbols.advanced: Distribute independent service calls across owned child processes while preserving each public Process Peer lifecycle.
overloadSignatures: export declare function createProcessPool<TRemote = Record<never, never>>(options: IProcessPoolOptions): Promise<IProcessPool<TRemote>>;
symbols.whenToUse: Distribute independent service calls across owned child processes while preserving each public Process Peer lifecycle.

symbols.name: IProcessPool
symbols.signature: export type IProcessPool<TRemote = Record<never, never>> = Pick<Awaited<ReturnType<typeof createProcessPeer<TRemote>>>, 'request' | 'notify' | 'stream'> & IRpcPoolControls;
symbols.purpose: Caller-owned pool returned by createProcessPool. Preserves Process request, notify and stream types with no native transfer list, adding the same pool-owned lifecycle controls as Thread pools.
symbols.core:
request: Schedules one original Process Peer request. Queue waiting does not start the native deadline; the occupied slot is released only when the original result promise settles. Pool scheduling never retries a failed business call.
request.method: Dotted method path declared by the spawned Process provide API and checked against TRemote.
request.args: Original payload and Process call options from the application, including signal, timeoutMs and idempotencyKey. Process public types prohibit native transfer lists; the pool preserves that prohibition.
Promise of the original typed result after queued dispatch. Pool-owned admission may reject POOL_CLOSED, QUEUE_FULL or queued CALL_ABORTED; native and Peer errors keep original identity and source/code.
notify: Schedules one original Process Peer notification and holds its client slot until the send promise settles; no business response is awaited.
notify.method: One-way method route supplied by the spawned Process provide API.
notify.args: Original application payload and Process options, retaining caller cancellation and the prohibition on native transfer lists.
Promise<void> from the original send boundary after pool scheduling; pool queue failures use its own codes and original send failures pass through.
stream: Creates a lazy Process stream iterator, admitting work only at first next(). The slot remains owned until the original stream finishes or termination is forwarded; never starting it does not block pool close.
stream.method: Iterator method path provided by the spawned Process program and checked against TRemote.
stream.args: Original payload and Process stream options from the application, including signal; native transfer lists remain unsupported.
Original typed async iterator semantics behind pool admission. next() yields or rejects unchanged; return(value) and throw(error) forward original termination when available and release the slot exactly once.
stats: Returns the current pool client-slot and FIFO snapshot, including during or after close. This does not measure provider concurrency or native worker load.
Frozen IRpcPoolStats with target size, acquired member count, actual dispatched in-flight slots, queued waiters and pool state.
resize: Serializes target-size changes in call order. Expansion acquires a transactional batch; shrink retires idle members first and waits for busy retired members to finish their accepted operations.
resize.size: New positive integer target selected by the caller; it replaces the construction target after this resize is admitted.
Promise<void> after acquisition or retirement. Invalid size uses INVALID_OPTIONS; closure uses POOL_CLOSED. Expansion failure restores the previous target and retains the original factory failure.
close: Stops new admission, drains accepted queue entries and operations, then closes every owned member once. Long streams must end, return, throw or be cancelled to release their slot before drain can finish.

symbols.purpose: Stable pool-owned semantic codes for invalid configuration, closed admission, queue overflow, queued abort and aggregated member cleanup. Native error classes and original causes remain intact.
symbols.core:
invalidOptions: Construction or resize input is invalid; fix the option before native member acquisition.
poolClosed: A closing or closed pool rejects a new operation or resize; create a new pool for new work.
queueFull: All client slots are busy and the bounded FIFO is full; no member receives the rejected operation.
callAborted: An operation was cancelled while waiting in the FIFO; native AbortError cause retains the exact signal reason.
closeFailed: Every member close was attempted and one or more failed; AggregateError retains errors and the first original cause.

symbols.purpose: Client scheduling lifecycle reported by stats(): open accepts work, closing drains accepted operations, closed records completed member cleanup attempts. It does not describe individual native supervisor generations.
symbols.core:
open: Accepts new operations, dispatches free slots and queues accepted overflow within maxQueue.
closing: Rejects new operations while draining accepted work and closing all owned members.
closed: All member closes have been attempted; stats remains readable but no new calls are admitted.
